label: Plot beat
description: One step of a plotline: what happens, which act it falls in, what brings it about and what it sets in motion. Beats are ordered within their act on the plot board; the shape of the whole plotline belongs to Plot, and an event's place in story time to Timeline event.

fields.label: What happens
fields.help: The beat itself, in a sentence or two: who does what, and what is different afterwards.

fields.label: Act
fields.help: The part of the book this beat falls in, from the opening that breaks the world through escalation and crisis to the resolution. Beats are ordered within their act on the plot board.

fields.label: What the beat does
fields.help: The job this beat does for its plotline, judged by what it changes rather than where it falls.

options.label: Brings opposing sides face to face

fields.label: What brings it about
fields.help: The decision, accident or earlier beat that makes this one happen, or a note that it arrives without warning.

fields.label: What it sets in motion
fields.help: What follows from this beat, for the people in it and for the plotline, and which later beats depend on it.

fields.label: How far the stakes move
fields.help: How much more, or less, there is to lose once this beat is over.

fields.label: What the reader is left with
fields.help: The question, worry or expectation a reader should carry out of this beat into the next.

fields.label: Threads left open
fields.help: What this beat starts or leaves unresolved that a later beat must pick up, one per item.

fields.label: How one leads to the other
fields.help: The chain from the first to the second: what makes the second follow from it, rather than merely come after it.

fields.label: What the reader sees of the link
fields.help: Whether the reader notices the connection as it happens, later on, or only when looking back.

fields.label: What lies between them
fields.help: What happens, or is deliberately left out, between the first and the second.
